title: Research: make features easier to find and less distracting
note: Doc "Easier to find, less distracting" is ready (private). Top wins: make the Quick setup values the defaults, label the Timers icon, cut notifications to the ones the person asked for, test 5 people before 4 Dec.
details: Studies, UX practice and tools on discoverability, choice overload, defaults, notifications and showing time. Ends with 12 experiments ranked by effort and impact. Research only, no app code.
